The GlimStone version in the About card points at a release that exists.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **The design-language version links to a published release.** It read 1.6.0 and pointed at a tag that had never been released, so following it went nowhere useful. GlimStone 1.6.0 is a real release now, with everything that had been accumulating behind four unreleased version numbers folded into it. The rule behind the fix is the more useful part: a version on screen is a promise that something with that name exists to read, so the number does not move until there is a release to point at.

Settings live under **Extension options › About this browser extension**.
